notes.title: Halloween update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I just updated Mystwood Manor with some bonus  Halloween outfits for all staff members.
I have also added one new (unlockable) guest.

Thank you all very much for the great support so far!

Enjoy the update and Happy Halloween!
Faerin

notes.title: Mystwood Manor update v1.0.3
notes.content:
Hey guys,

I fixed a bug causing the "Time to talk" event not to trigger for some players.
As well as some minor typos and bugs.

Thanks a lot for all the positive feedback so far, I hope you will continue to enjoy the game!

All the best,
Faerin
